metadata.title: Roadmap Story
metadata.subject: Three-slide roadmap narrative for any product or platform team
metadata.author: PresentationKit

processFlow.title: How the roadmap becomes credible
processFlow.subtitle: A roadmap story links signals, prioritization, sequencing, commitments, and learning.
processFlow.caption: The story explains why this order is responsible.

footprint.title: Roadmap scope
footprint.subtitle: A neutral view of where the roadmap is active and where discovery continues.
footprint.caption: Scope is explicit so expectations stay realistic.

architecture.title: Roadmap evidence model
architecture.subtitle: Inputs become trade-off decisions and reviewable delivery commitments.

slides.label: 1 / roadmap context
slides.title: Roadmaps need a story, not only a list
slides.headline: The useful roadmap explains why the sequence is responsible.
slides.supportingLine: Start with the signals, constraints, and learning loop that make the roadmap credible.
slides.speakerNotes: Frame the roadmap as a set of choices made under evidence and constraints.

slides.label: 2 / roadmap proof
slides.title: The roadmap is backed by evidence and trade-offs
slides.headline: Each theme has a reason to exist and a reason to wait or move now.
slides.supportingLine: Artifacts make the roadmap reviewable: signals, decision notes, and milestone assumptions.
slides.guardrailLine: Guardrails: no fake certainty; date ranges over promises; assumptions stay visible.
slides.speakerNotes: Show how the roadmap can be challenged, adjusted, and improved without losing the narrative.

slides.label: 3 / roadmap ambition
slides.title: The dream: roadmap conversations become better decisions
slides.headline: A shared narrative helps teams adapt without reopening every priority debate.
slides.closingLine: Make the roadmap easier to trust by making the reasoning easier to inspect.
slides.speakerNotes: Close on alignment and adaptability rather than pretending the plan will not change.
